archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that the plan's removal inventory is complete: check the Makefile for all three claimed occurrences of test-merge-parity (.PHONY line, test-harnesses-5 shard line, standalone target+recipe), check docs/linting.md for the claimed table row (~line 264), and search scripts/test-harness-shards-coverage.sh and any other non-larch-logs scripts for additional references the plan may have missed. The plan states 'No other file references test-merge-parity (only historical larch-logs/ artifacts)' — validate this claim against the actual working tree. Flag any location the plan omits that would leave a dangling reference after the edit. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.rationale: Plan claims that deleting the target without a carve-out keeps test-harness-shards-coverage green and that py-test still collects test_merge_bash_parity.py — if either invariant is wrong the PR will break CI.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read scripts/test-harness-shards-coverage.sh to understand exactly what it checks: does it fail on a test-* target that is listed in .PHONY but not sharded, or only on sharded targets that have no matching rule, or something else? Also verify the plan's claim that cd python && pytest collects python/test_merge_bash_parity.py by checking the file exists and has no skip markers or conftest exclusions that would silently drop it.
